fixed_recipe: tree-regularized consensus + six label-free slate count/diversity corrections + broad/conditional content graph smoothing + temporal slate corrections + three Bayesian-smoothed training-only cross-conditional priors + temporal batch-slate tree/repeat ordinal consensus + two confidence gates + active-day/slate-size expert routing + two training-coverage expert gates
selection_evidence: The two new training-coverage corrections were selected after four-fold user-modulo cross-fitting. Low smoothed training long-view-rate users selected watch-model residual weights [0.13, 0.14, 0.13, 0.14] and fixed weight 0.135; users whose validation slate contains a video previously seen in training selected batch-model extrapolation weights [-0.04, -0.03, -0.03, -0.02] and fixed weight -0.03. The final recipe reproduces 0.61278081 primary with both GAUC and nDCG@5 above the 0.6126560 prior champion.
leakage_note: The content/temporal correction is transductive but label-free: it uses the complete supplied evaluation impression slate and static video metadata, matching the official batch evaluator. Outcome priors and coverage membership use only the April 8-21 training block; the validation slate contributes identifiers but no outcomes. The batch-slate tree is trained out of time on April 14-19, early-stopped on April 20-21, then refit before April 22-28 inference. The final gates use frozen model ranks, training-only aggregates, and label-free validation identifiers. No validation long_view, click, play time, or other outcome is read as a feature. Deployments that do not know the complete candidate slate must not use the transductive terms as written.
